intended_use: Research screening support on anonymized/test data. Not a diagnosis; not validated for clinical use.

pipeline.pooling: max over all time frames (chunk_seconds = null)
pipeline.standardization: StandardScaler fit on the training split only (scaler.npz)
pipeline.head: Linear(1024,128) - ReLU - Linear(128,1); sigmoid = P(ALS). No dropout layer in this run's weights.
pipeline.decision_rule: p >= 0.5 for the reported test counts

training_config.selection: minimum val loss epoch; maximum val ACC layer
training_config.not_recorded: weight decay is not in run_config.json

data_split.dataset: SAND Challenge Task 1 training sheet; Class 5 = HC (0), Class 1-4 = ALS (1)

test.level: recording (328 recordings from 41 held-out subjects); not subject-level aggregation

notes: The repository notebook (MAX_EPOCHS 20, PATIENCE 3, LR 5e-4) is a later edit whose saved output is run 20261005T080540_357849Z. The deployed weights come from the earlier run 20261005T055211_070474Z (max_epochs 100, patience 20, lr 1e-3) with the same split_hash and feature pipeline.
limitations: Test metrics are internal (same SAND distribution and recording protocol). They are not the performance of the deployed app on phone recordings, other microphones, or other populations.
About 8 recordings per subject: recording-level metrics overstate the effective sample size.
Specificity (58.6%) is low relative to sensitivity at the 0.5 threshold; no clinical operating point was validated.
Check 6 recomputes 4 of 328 test samples (2 HC, 2 ALS, one misclassified each) from cached features; the remaining samples are covered by checks 1 and 5.
